# todo.md - House of Fun Clone Implementation Checklist

*Note: Playtika regularly cycles a rotating roster of over 400 slots. This checklist covers the core franchise engines, major documented Vegas/3D/Fairy Tale slots, all metagame side-features, and expanded table game engines required for a 1:1 clone.*

## Meta & Side Games
- [ ] **HoF Album (Like a Pro)** - Card collection mechanic to complete albums for massive coin payouts.
- [ ] **Wheel of Fun** - Daily/hourly login wheel for free coins and multiplier bonuses.
- [ ] **Star Market** - Trading system for duplicate cards to buy fantastic bonuses and exclusive avatars.
- [ ] **Lucky Cards Mini Game** - Triggered upon pulling specific cards for extra randomized prizes.
- [ ] **Monsterpedia Challenges** - Gamified leveling map linked to specific monster-themed slot releases.
- [ ] **Playtika Rewards System** - Cross-game loyalty point tracking and VIP tier progression.
- [ ] **Daily Dash / Exclusive Challenges** - Daily progressing mission passes with daily, weekly, and monthly rewards.

## Blackjack (Table Games Expansion)
- [ ] **Classic Blackjack** - Standard 6-deck Vegas rules, dealer stands on soft 17, double down on any two cards.
- [ ] **European Blackjack** - Dealer does not receive a hole card until the player finishes their hand; no peeking for blackjack.
- [ ] **Blackjack Switch** - Player plays two hands simultaneously and can switch the top cards between hands to optimize their odds.
- [ ] **Perfect Pairs Blackjack** - Classic rules with a lucrative side bet that pays out if the player's initial two cards form a pair (mixed, colored, or perfect).

## Video Poker (Table Games Expansion)
- [ ] **Jacks or Better** - The foundational video poker experience; payouts begin at a pair of Jacks.
- [ ] **Deuces Wild** - Fast-paced variant where all "2" cards act as wilds, substituting for any other card to build winning hands.
- [ ] **Bonus Poker** - Similar to Jacks or Better but offers premium bonus payouts for specific four-of-a-kind hands (like four Aces).
- [ ] **Joker Poker** - Played with a 53-card deck including one Joker that acts as a wild; requires Kings or Better to qualify for a win.

## Roulette (Table Games Expansion)
- [ ] **European Roulette** - Traditional single-zero (0) wheel offering a lower house edge and standard inside/outside betting.
- [ ] **American Roulette** - Features both a single zero (0) and double zero (00) wheel with an adjusted betting layout.
- [ ] **French Roulette** - Single-zero wheel featuring the "La Partage" rule, where players receive half their even-money bets back if the ball lands on zero.
- [ ] **Multi-Wheel Roulette** - Allows the player to place one set of bets that are active across up to 6 simultaneously spinning European roulette wheels.
